uncertainty.note: scatter is the SPREAD of per-line values and is the frontier result itself (RYA-777); the pseudo-continuum term does NOT average down.

window_sweep_note: Non-monotonic across 0.25/0.40/0.60 A, so this is fit noise of amplitude 0.070 dex rather than a trend with window width. The production EW-keyed rule cannot run here: theoretical_ew is all zero in this list and no measured EW exists (profile fitting was falsified in this band), so the half-width is a forced choice and is reported as a systematic.
gf_provenance: canonical_gf.csv starts at 3780.0 A; this band starts at 3000.0 A, so canonical gf single-sourcing (RYA-353) is NOT available and the list's own VALD log gf is used as delivered. Per-line VALD gf SOURCES are recorded, but no canonical adjudication exists below 3780.0 A.
caveats: GATE PASSES ON COMPENSATING ERRORS: the SynthesisHandler optical control is -0.0100 dex on abundance but 1.433 on EW ratio (MAD 0.359). Its own verdict: "ABUNDANCE AGREES, EW DOES NOT ... Treat with MORE suspicion than a clean failure, because it looks like success." This number inherits that.
NO gf single-sourcing below 3780 A (canonical_gf.csv starts at 3780.04 A); VALD gf used as delivered, accuracy unadjudicated for 127 source tags.
NO molecular opacity in-band from either source (VALD has no isotopologue code; iSpec molecular lists start at 400 nm).
Pseudo-continuum systematic 0.1 dex does NOT average down and is NOT in the scatter above.
No measured EW exists in this band, so the production EW-keyed window rule cannot apply; half-width is fixed and must be swept.
LTE only. UV Fe I is heavily over-ionized, so the missing NLTE correction is large and POSITIVE -- a low value here is expected physics, not a bug.

validation_status.why: RYA-777 ratified that IR/near-UV validate against SAME-REGIME published measurements, never the optical anchor. No near-UV solar Fe literature is staged in this repo, so that comparison is OWED and is recorded as owed rather than substituted with the optical value.
validation_status.optical_comparison_is: a REPORTED cross-band difference, NOT a validation. The gold 7.466 is on the 3D scale; the 1D reference is 7.516 (RYA-669 ratchet), and this product is 1D.
